Cinematic, photorealistic video. A modern Korean news studio interior with a clean, professional design. Large LED panels glow softly in the background, showing animated graphics and a scrolling news ticker. On the ticker, the words “속보: AI시대의 서비스 디자인 수업 휴강” are displayed in Korean.

At the center of the frame sits a poised Korean news anchor, wearing a formal suit, looking directly into the camera with a calm and confident expression. The anchor holds a few cue cards and begins speaking in clear Korean with a natural broadcast tone:

“오늘의 속보를 알려드립니다. 추석 연휴를 맞아 AI시대의 서비스 디자인 수업이 휴강한다고 합니다.”

Lighting is bright and evenly balanced, highlighting the anchor’s face and creating a professional newsroom atmosphere. The camera angle is a steady medium shot, slightly zooming in as the anchor delivers the breaking news. A lower-third graphic appears on screen with bold Korean text:

“속보 - AI시대의 서비스 디자인 휴강”

submissions.author: 이윤수
submissions.promptProcess:
Use the attached logo as a reference, and reinterpret only the hummingbird figure from the logo in a dreamy dreamcore style.
Keep the overall hummingbird silhouette, pose, and recognizable shape from the original logo clearly intact, but transform it into a soft, surreal, dreamy visual.

Create a square 1:1 composition.
The hummingbird should be the main subject, centered or slightly floating in the frame, with a whimsical, nostalgic, dreamlike atmosphere.

Apply a rich velvet texture to the hummingbird body and wings, making it look soft, plush, slightly luminous, and tactile.
Surround the hummingbird with a dreamcore night-sky environment: soft glowing stars, fluffy clouds, hazy moonlight, dreamy gradients, misty air, subtle sparkles, and a surreal midnight sky.

The mood should feel soft, emotional, nostalgic, ethereal, surreal, and slightly magical, with a comforting but uncanny dreamcore aesthetic.
Use a palette of deep navy, midnight blue, lavender, dusty pink, soft peach, muted coral, warm beige, and faint silver highlights.

The image should feel like a velvety dreamscape illustration rather than a flat logo.
Keep the hummingbird elegant and iconic, but enhance it with dreamy textures and atmospheric lighting.

No typography, no badge frame, no logo text, no extra branding.
Focus only on the hummingbird and the surrounding dreamcore sky elements.

Highly detailed, soft lighting, soft glow, velvet fabric texture, dreamy clouds, sparkling stars, surreal night atmosphere, clean composition, visually poetic, premium illustration.
submissions.content: ChatGPT의 미드저니 V6 미드저니 프롬프트 생성을 통해, 제 사업자 로고를 첨부하여 드림코어 느낌으로 생성하기 위한 프롬프트를 생성하고, 미드저니에서는 pinterest를 통해 서치한 드림코어 이미지를 무드보드화하여, 생성하였습니다. 1차로 생성된 이미지의 텍스트를 edit 기능을 이용해 지우고, 부분적으로 큐빅을 더 추가해달라고 명령하였습니다.
